description: Work-queue view for the authenticated user (or a given assignee/group). Defaults to open incidents assigned to you, sorted by due_at ascending. Each row includes a computed SLA risk level for at-a-glance triage. Supports assignee_email override (client-side filter), assigned_to_group (server-side), states/priorities filters, and sort_by options.

assigned_to_group.description: Filter to incidents assigned to this group ID (server-side). When set without assignee_email, defaults to group mode instead of "my" mode.

assignee_email.description: Override the default (authenticated user) with a specific assignee email. Applied client-side because SWSD ignores it server-side.

per_page.description: Results per page (1-100). SWSD caps at 100.

priorities.description: Filter to incidents matching ANY of these priorities.

state_is_not.description: Negative state filter. Defaults to excluding Resolved and Closed (open work only).

states.description: Filter to incidents matching ANY of these states.

updated_from.description: Filter to incidents updated on or after this ISO date or datetime.

updated_within.description: Convenience alias for updated_from: "Nh" is an exact hours-ago ISO timestamp; "Nd" and "Nw" use the UTC calendar date N days or N weeks ago. N must be 1-365. Ignored if updated_from is explicitly set.

name: swsd_my_queue

assignee_email.description: The email used as the assignee filter (resolved from JWT when not overridden).

has_more.description: True when more pages exist beyond this one.

matched_total.description: Total matching records, or null when unknown. After local filtering, known only when all candidate pages were scanned from page 1. Independent of display caps.

next_page.description: The next page number to request, when has_more is true.

per_page.description: Items per page used in the request.

total.description: Total record count when SWSD returns X-Total-Count.

total_scope.description: Scope of the upstream `total`: 'upstream' = candidates before local filtering; 'filtered' = server-filtered count with no local filtering; 'tenant' = unfiltered count; 'unknown' = total absent. Sorting and display options are not filters.
